# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When the user gives a screenshot and says parts of the design are approved, preserve those regions exactly and only modify the explicitly requested area; interpret screenshot composition carefully instead of approximating it with a generic redesign.
- For the Projects carousel, implement only the featured carousel followed by one horizontal row of project names, highlighting the active item with the current slide. Ensure the active image/card subtly pops out and hovers, while adjacent project images are visibly smaller. Do not add a duplicate image/description preview grid below the carousel, and preserve the approved title and category-filter row unchanged.
